items.name: Chronic kidney disease (eGFR)
evidence: Physician records: Chronic kidney disease (eGFR) evaluation. Blood pressure 127/81 mmHg, weight 253 lbs. Patient reported feeling well overall. Kidney function test indicated an eGFR of 40, prompting further management and dietary counseling.

Physician records: Patient diagnosed with chronic kidney disease, currently controlled with an eGFR of 38. The eGFR trend over the past year shows values of 37 (August 2025), 36 (December 2024), and 40 (April 2024).
